correctness.rationale: The two affine triangles each map onto the whole triangle, as seen on their respective three vertices; the formulas agree on the fold and the determinants are −2 and +2. Thus area is invariant at t=1, and pushforward of area at t is t⁻² times area restricted to tΩ. In radial-edge coordinates (x,y)=(z(2−s),zs), with 0≤z,s≤1, the absolute Jacobian is 2z and the lost region is z>t. Its area divided by 1−t tends weak-* to 2 ds on the right edge; dividing the pushforward difference by t−1 gives ν_R−2m with the stated sign. The right and diagonal parametrizations both map to (2s,0), while the bottom parametrization (x,0) maps to (min(x,2−x),min(x,2−x)), giving multiplicity two on the diagonal. These give exact identities on all continuous observables, not just moments; the branch meeting and vertices cause no atom. The Cesàro limit of this forcing is (ν_B+ν_L)/2−2m, nonzero by its interior test integrals. For any weak-* convergent subsequence Banach–Steinhaus bounds its TV norm; uniform convergence F_t→F_1 then allows passage of the pushforward in the invariance equation, producing (I−F_{1*})η=B. Its Cesàro sum telescopes to (η−F_{1*}^Nη)/N and goes to zero in TV because pushforward contracts TV, contradicting the nonzero limit. A bounded sequence of L¹ quotients would give a weak-* convergent subsequence by bounded weak-* metrizability on a compact metric Ω, so every such sequence is excluded. The L¹ density norm is exactly the TV norm of the signed measure here.
residual_risks: Existence and uniqueness of the ACIP are a cited input. The written analytic argument, not the bundled finite polynomial checks, proves the weak-* and L¹ conclusions. No asymptotic divergence rate or failure for an individual smooth observable is established.

Alves–Etubi Theorem C and ensuing linear-response question
value.rationale: This gives an endpoint obstruction for a published, naturally parameterized two-dimensional family explicitly raised in the response literature. It rules out uniformly bounded linear scaling of stationary densities and rules out finite-measure response even subsequentially, rather than merely failing to produce a derivative. The exact boundary cycle is a concrete geometric mechanism, not just a numerical instability.
residual_risks: It is not a resolution of response at all parameters or in larger distribution spaces, and it gives no matching lower rate for the published upper modulus.
